newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran executes six men for murder.
newsitem.headline: Iran executes six men for murder.

text.p: Iran has hanged six men, including two brothers, for murder, newspapers said on Sunday.
The men were hanged on Thursday in Tehran's Qasr prison yard, according to the Iran daily. A judge was present during the executions, it said.
While the two brothers acted together, the four other men committed their murders separately, the paper said. All murders took place in Tehran province last year.
